label: sdc01_0050_brother_01
text: Sis! Look! There! There’s one now![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_01
text: So...you’re one of those students who came from\nthe Paldea region, huh?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0050_brother_02
text: Whoa... Way cool...[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_02
text: Hush, Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_03
text: I’m Carmine.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_04
text: Sorry, but I can’t just let an outsider like you\nwander into Mossui Town.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_05
text: If you insist on coming in, you’ll have to battle\nme first.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_brother_03
text: C-c’mon, Sis... You just wanna battle. Makin’ this\nbig fuss over nothing...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_06
text: I told you to hush, Kiki![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_07
text: Just ignore my little brother.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_08
text: All right, let’s do this. Get in position.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_09
text: I’m going to have some real good fun with you.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_brother_05
text: Wowzers! You went and beat my sis?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0050_brother_06
text: Wowzers! You’re almost as strong as my sis![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_10
text: I can’t believe it... There’s no way you should’ve\nbeen able to beat me![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_15
text: Huh... Didn’t expect you to put up such a fight\nagainst me.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_11
text: ...Fine, I guess you pass. Barely.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_12
text: Seems I’ve got no choice. I’ll let you into town,\nbut only if you become one of my grunts and do\r\nevery little thing I—[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_01
text: Oi! What’re you doing, causing a ruckus out here![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_13
text: Tch. Here comes trouble...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_sister_14
text: C’mon, Kiki. We’re out of here.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0050_brother_08
text: Wait up, Sis![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_02
text: Why, hello there, stranger! You must be one of\nthe students from that Paldean academy, right?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_03
text: I help run the community center here in Mossui\nTown—and a fair few other things besides!\r\nI’ll be looking after your group during your visit.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_04
text: I hope those two kids weren’t giving you any\ngrief just now...were they?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_05
text: I hardly know what to do with the two of them...\nEspecially that Carmine. Always been a handful,\r\nthat one. I apologize if she gave you a hard time.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_06
text: What’s that?! A member of your group fell ill\ndown by the bus stop?![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_07
text: I’d better get over there and give them a hand\nso they can make it into town![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_08
text: I’ll take care of everything. You go ahead and get\nyourself settled in at the community center.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_09
text: We’ll catch up with you soon![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0050_caretaker_10
text: The road to this town is awful pitted and bumpy.\nIt’s not unusual for folks to get carsick from it.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0050_bbteacher_01
text: Motion sickness happens when something upsets\nthe sensory system in your ears that helps you\r\nmaintain balance. All that shaking will do it![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0050_stopper_01
text: Better head to the community center!
